fields.publicReference: varchar(32), unique, cryptographically random opaque receipt; not an authorization credential
fields.contactSnapshot: jsonb <=16384 bytes; immutable submission-time snapshot of contact, optional region/deadline wording and optional customer comment; exact properties defined in OpenAPI
fields.catalogProductContext: varchar(120) nullable; untrusted product-card hint copied from the public form; never resolved, linked, matched or used as authority
fields.kindDetails: jsonb <=32768 bytes; immutable strict version-1 union selected by kind
fields.uploadProfileCode: enum MVP_SAFE|ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS; server-selected at creation, never client-supplied, immutable for this Inquiry
fields.uploadCapabilityHash: bytea(32), nullable SHA-256 of client-generated 256-bit capability; never the raw capability
fields.uploadCapabilityExpiresAt: timestamptz(6) nullable, recommended 24 hours after creation when capability exists
fields.assignedManagerUserId: uuid nullable FK StaffUser.id ON DELETE RESTRICT
fields.assignedEngineerUserId: uuid nullable FK StaffUser.id ON DELETE RESTRICT
fields.stageDueAt: timestamptz(6) nullable; human-set internal due date for the current stage, distinct from customer desiredDeadline; cleared on each successful status transition

checks: status and kind are declared enums
kindDetails schema is selected by kind and version=1
uploadProfileCode is a declared server-side upload profile
catalogProductContext is NULL or <=120 characters and has no catalog FK
uploadCapabilityHash is NULL or exactly 32 bytes
uploadCapabilityHash and uploadCapabilityExpiresAt are both NULL or both present
version > 0
Inquiry.immutability: kind, publicReference, contactSnapshot, catalogProductContext, kindDetails, uploadProfileCode and createdAt never change after creation. uploadCapabilityHash and uploadCapabilityExpiresAt may only be cleared together once during an authorized pre-quote close as one-way revocation; they cannot be rotated or reissued. Assignments/status/stageDueAt/version may change only through audited OCC commands; no physical delete API.

checks: expectedSha256 NULL or 32 bytes
state is a declared enum
receivingStartedAt and receivingDeadlineAt are both NULL or both present; if a stream started, retain both timestamps in RECEIVING and terminal states
when state=RECEIVING, receivingDeadlineAt equals receivingStartedAt plus the deadline of the immutable parent Inquiry.uploadProfileCode
version > 0
InquiryUploadIntent.completionInvariant: A byte stream may start only while state=ISSUED and clock_timestamp()<expiresAt; one transaction changes it to RECEIVING and sets receiving timestamps. Intent start expiry does not abort a started stream; receivingDeadlineAt applies the receiving bound from the immutable parent Inquiry.uploadProfileCode. Before final commit, the transaction locks the Inquiry and confirms the same uploadCapabilityHash remains present; if the capability was revoked during RECEIVING, mark the intent FAILED, create no source document and do not consume the intent. At or after receivingDeadlineAt, abort, mark FAILED and attach no source document. The only transition to CONSUMED occurs in the transaction that inserts the unique InquirySourceDocument, AuditEvent and idempotency receipt. The composite FK enforces the same Inquiry; the unique uploadIntentId permits at most one source document.
InquiryUploadIntent.immutability: Intent binding and file declaration are immutable; state changes only by one-use upload/cancel/expiry/validation commands under row lock.

fields.actorStaffUserId: uuid nullable FK StaffUser.id; required iff actorKind=STAFF
fields.requestHash: bytea(32), SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical validated command; upload content commands include actual byte SHA-256, detected MIME, size and bound intent ID
fields.responseReceipt: jsonb <=8192 bytes, sanitized replay response only; never request body, capability, PII, or storage key
fields.expiresAt: timestamptz(6), 30-day retention for all inquiry command records

checks: actorKind=PUBLIC iff actorStaffUserId IS NULL
request and key hashes are exactly 32 bytes
responseReceipt contains no PII or file secrets
InquiryCommandIdempotency.transaction: Insert command reservation, domain mutation, same-transaction AuditEvent and exact status/receipt in one PostgreSQL transaction. The unique index serializes same-key races; a failed transaction leaves none of these writes. Same key/hash replays; same key/different hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Deterministic OCC/domain 409 is durably replayed without domain mutation or success audit. Before staff receipt lookup/replay, revalidate current session, CSRF/Origin, effective action permission and Inquiry read scope. Before public upload receipt lookup/replay, revalidate an unexpired matching capability and intent binding; failed authorization never returns the saved result.

kindDetails.EQUIPMENT: No extra kind-specific object; region, verbatim desiredDeadline wording and customerComment are optional fields in contactSnapshot. At least one InquiryLine is required.
kindDetails.PANELS: Strict object: requestType PROJECT_READY|MODIFY_TYPICAL|DEVELOP_FROM_BRIEF and non-empty description/task are required; cabinetPurpose and positive quantity are optional; requirements is optional free text; requestedWork is an optional list; documentationAvailability is UNKNOWN|AVAILABLE|PARTIAL|NONE when supplied; notes are optional. Shared region, deadline wording and customer comment are in contactSnapshot. Preserve all submitted wording.
kindDetails.ENGINEERING: Strict object: non-empty technicalTask/subject is required; engineeringDirection, systemType, expectedDeliverables/outcomes, sourceDocumentDescription, scope and notes are optional bounded text. Shared region, deadline wording and customer comment are in contactSnapshot. Preserve all submitted wording.

rules.audit: Reuse existing R1-002 AuditEvent append-only table and actor model. Add only R1-010 entity/action registry entries; audit records actor/time/entity/result, never contact snapshots, inquiry line text, comment body, filename, byte, capability, IP or raw request.
rules.fileStorage: Do not reuse R1-002 FileObject/FileVersion/FileLink rows: frozen R1-002 requires staff ownership and has no anonymous owner. Reuse only the configured private StoragePort implementation with a dedicated inquiry-quarantine namespace and InquirySourceDocument domain policy. Do not alter R1-002/R1-006 schemas.
rules.atomicity: Inquiry, its lines, public receipt and inquiry.created audit commit atomically. Uploads happen later and independently; a failed upload never rolls back the Inquiry or prior documents. Each completed upload metadata, one-use intent consumption, idempotency result and audit commit atomically after private blob write; exact-write compensation is attempted on DB failure, otherwise a private orphan is flagged for bounded cleanup. No partial document becomes downloadable.
rules.retention: Exact inquiry/contact/document retention requires OD-010-02/03. No production launch or automatic deletion policy may be inferred. Incomplete byte streams are deleted after 24 hours by an ownership-checked private storage sweeper; expired intent metadata is retained 30 days for diagnostics then purged. Completed InquirySourceDocument rows/bytes remain until owner-approved retention exists.
rules.idempotencyRetention: 30 days; after expiration the client must never reuse a key. Cleanup deletes only expired rows after locking and does not touch inquiry, AuditEvent or source files.
rules.limits: See the canonical FROZEN MVP_SAFE and ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS profiles in R1-010-inquiry-upload-profiles.json. The server assigns one immutable uploadProfileCode to every Inquiry; clients cannot select a profile. OpenAPI carries the 50 MiB maximum schema ceiling while the selected profile enforces the lower runtime file/count/aggregate limits.
rules.uploadQuotaConcurrency: Creating and starting/completing each upload intent locks the Inquiry aggregate and rechecks completed documents by actual bytes, unexpired ISSUED reservations by declared bytes, and RECEIVING reservations by declared bytes until completion/failure/deadline against that Inquiry's immutable profile. The source/UTC-day budget is one atomic Redis counter across all Inquiry IDs for the HMAC source. It charges declared bytes once at accepted intent creation; retries do not double-charge and failed/cancelled/expired intents are not refunded. The bucket's effective cap is the lowest profile cap seen for that source/day; it is not reset, refunded or widened before UTC rollover.
rules.publicUploadCapability: Contract Amendment 01: the client sends a 256-bit capability only in X-Inquiry-Upload-Capability. The API stores only SHA-256, uses a unique nullable uploadCapabilityHash index to resolve one unexpired Inquiry, then binds intentId to that Inquiry. Missing, invalid, expired and revoked values are non-enumerating denials; publicReference and UUIDs are not credentials. The trusted staff close operation requires inquiries.transition, current read scope, If-Match and idempotency; in the same locked transaction it clears hash and expiry together and audits only the changed field names. No public route or permission is added. This is the only revocation path; the DB rejects partial clear, changed hash, expiry changes and reissue. A RECEIVING upload rechecks the stored hash under the Inquiry row lock before final document commit.
